Bill.BriefDescription: Collecting royalties for fossil fuel production.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fossil fuel production; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to establish amethodology of collecting royalties for fossil fuel production in thestate of Washington. Further, the legislature intends to establish asystem that is consistent with other systems used in the PacificNorthwest.
